faq.question: How long does a typical UI/UX project take?
faq.answer: A focused design sprint takes 1–2 weeks; full product design usually runs 4–8 weeks depending on scope.

faq.question: Will I get source files?
faq.answer: Yes — you receive full Figma/XD source files along with exported assets and specs.
